# OpenVibe.VIP

> Memberships across the OpenVibe network: subscribe to the people you watch, with badges, emotes, early access and gated posts set by creators, and one network membership that supports the whole network. OpenVibe.VIP is not open yet; it launches with the network's Billing cutover. Channel subscriptions already exist on OpenVibe.Live.

## Today

- [OpenVibe.Live](https://openvibe.live/): live streaming, where channel subscriptions work now
- [OpenVibe.Network](https://openvibe.network/): one OpenVibe account for every site, and the OpenCoins wallet

## Not open yet

- [OpenVibe.Tips](https://openvibe.tips/): tips, goals and alert overlays, launching with OpenVibe.VIP
